title: The black mailbox began as a vague landmark

tellings.quote: So, I just said, "It's around the black mailbox."

plain: The black mailbox, a spot in the Nevada desert that later became famous among people watching for UFOs, started out as nothing more than a rough landmark Bob Lazar gave in 1989. Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site, tells Michels he did it himself: asked where to look, he simply said, 'It's around the black mailbox.' If his account is right, a well-known meeting point grew out of one offhand direction.
